concerns.text: The plan states it will acquire “≥ 10 UCI/OpenML datasets … and all three size bins” (binary/continuous outcomes, size bins < 64, 64‑200, > 200). However, the dataset list in research.md misclassifies the Breast Cancer Wisconsin Diagnostic dataset (569 rows) as `< 64` and provides no dataset actually under 64 rows. This violates FR‑001, which requires at least one dataset in each size bin, making the dataset selection inappropriate for the research question.
